case: A statement failure after an earlier write cannot complete explicit rollback when its backend is terminated
contract: The batch inserts one row, then blocks in SELECT pg_sleep(60) inside the same transaction.
A separate monitor identifies and terminates that active PostgreSQL backend.
The driver reports TransactionRollbackFailed at statement index 1, with the statement and rollback failures classified as disconnected.
A fresh query confirms PostgreSQL did not retain the earlier uncommitted insert after backend termination.

focused_test.command: rtk proxy cargo test --locked -p tablepro-driver-postgres --test integration a_batch_reports_rollback_failure_after_postgres_terminates_its_backend -- --ignored --exact --test-threads=1
